The test image shows soybean plants viewed from above, focusing on the lower canopy. Key observations:
- Yellow/chlorotic patches on leaves, particularly visible in the center of the image
- Small angular brown-to-yellow spots scattered on leaves
- Lower canopy affected with some defoliation visible on the ground
- No visible white mold, pustules, or stem symptoms

This pattern — angular yellow-brown spots on lower canopy leaves with yellowing progressing upward — closely matches **Septoria_brown_spot**. The reference image confirms the same pattern: scattered small brown spots causing leaves to yellow and drop from the bottom of the plant upward.
